nodes.name: ADMS cdata
nodes.notes: GET = handshake (must return the OPTIONS block). POST = data push.

nodes.name: Queue for Dataiku
nodes.notes: Confirm the table and column mapping in the UI after import - see README-queue.md.

nodes.name: ADMS getrequest
nodes.notes: Device polls this every Delay seconds for pending commands. "OK" = nothing queued.

nodes.name: ADMS devicecmd
nodes.notes: Command acknowledgement. Must return OK or the device retries the command forever.

nodes.name: Queue Pending
nodes.notes: Dataiku polls this. Same X-ZK-Secret credential as the device uses.

nodes.name: Queue Ack
nodes.notes: Dataiku calls this only after Snowflake accepted the rows.
